title: Instruction Quality Matters: Refining Instructions for Effective Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preference learning optimizes models using response pairs, yet the informativeness of these pairs is fundamentally shaped by the instructions from which they are generated. We identify instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning: low-quality or ambiguous instructions restrict the response-quality distribution, limiting strong chosen responses and weakening preference signals. Through Best- and Worst-of-N analyses, we show that instruction quality constrains both the ceiling and floor of sampled response quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce an instruction-refinement pipeline that selects weak instructions using reward signals and revises them with rubric-guided LLM feedback, improving preference data without discarding examples. Across offline and online preference learning settings, experiments on multiple models and benchmarks show broad alignment improvements over original data and alternative data

translated_title: 指令质量至关重要：优化指令以促进有效的偏好学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26779v1 公告类型：新 摘要：偏好学习利用响应配对来优化模型，然而这些配对的信息量从根本上受到生成它们的指令的影响。我们识别出指令质量是偏好学习中的一个隐藏瓶颈：低质量或模糊的指令限制了响应质量的分布，从而削弱了强选择响应并减弱了偏好信号。通过最佳和最差N项分析，我们表明指令质量同时限制了采样响应质量的上限和下限。基于这一观察，我们引入了一个指令优化流程，该流程利用奖励信号选择弱指令，并通过基于评分标准的LLM反馈对其进行修订，从而在不丢弃样本的情况下改进偏好数据。在离线和在线偏好学习设置中，对多个模型和基准的实验表明，与原始数据和替代数据相比，对齐性能得到了广泛提升。
tldr: 本文提出指令质量是偏好学习的隐藏瓶颈，并引入指令优化流程，通过选择弱指令和基于评分标准的LLM反馈修订，有效提升偏好数据质量，从而在离线和在线设置中显著改善模型对齐性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning and introduces an instruction-refinement pipeline that selects weak instructions and revises them with rubric-guided LLM feedback, improving preference data and broadly enhancing model alignment in both offline and online settings.
